Volume Normalization is a fundamental preprocessing step in volume rendering and medical image analysis pipelines.
It ensures that input data is within a standard range, which is critical for the stability of gradient-based optimization in neural networks and for consistent thresholding in segmentation tasks.

The method is widely used in conjunction with other preprocessing steps such as [Preprocessing Pipeline](6733-preprocessing-pipeline.md) and [Geometric Normalization](12018-geometric-normalization.md).
